title: Method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm
abstract: A method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm prevents unauthorized persons from firing the firearm. When a person picks up the firearm, a biometric scanner retrieves an unidentified biometric reading off of the person. The biometric scanner can be a palm-print reader and/or a fingerprint reader. If the unidentified biometric reading does not match an authorized user signature stored on a chipset of the firearm, and if the firearm has unlocked its trigger, then the firearm automatically locks its trigger. In addition, the firearm generates and broadcasts an unauthorized-use notification with a wireless communication module. If the unidentified biometric reading does match an authorized user signature stored on the chipset, and if the firearm has locked its trigger, then firearm automatically unlocks its trigger. The firearm also collects situational data from environmental sensors when the firearm discharges a round.

title: Intelligent weapon
abstract: A system for monitoring use of a weapon. The system includes a monitoring station and at least one weapon in which the weapon fires a projectile. The weapon includes a tracking device, in which the tracking device receives navigational data, and a transceiver. The transceiver transmits at least the navigational data to the monitoring station. The weapon can further include a biometric identifier for identifying a user and a trigger mechanism in which the biometric identifier can enable the trigger mechanism only when the biometric identifier identifies an authorized user. In one arrangement, the tracking device can be a global positioning system receiver that can receive navigational data from a plurality of global positioning system satellites.

title: Safety system with biometric locking applied in holders for size and controlled storage of firearms
abstract: SAFETY SYSTEM WITH BIOMETRIC LOCKING APPLIED IN HOLDERS FOR SIZE AND CONTROLLED STORAGE OF FIREARMS. The present invention patent application relates to a security system (1) described and applied to holsters (2) for the controlled storage of firearms. The present system includes a holster (2) with a locking mechanism (3) operated by a biometric sensor (4). Access to the weapon is restricted to authorized users whose fingerprints are recorded in the security system (1). The holster (2) is molded to fit specifically to the gun, ensuring a secure engagement and preventing accidental firing. The locking mechanism (3) has a locking handle (5) that covers the trigger of the weapon, blocking access to it. The locking handle (5) can only be unlocked by biometric authentication using the biometric sensor (4) strategically located in the holster (2). The biometric sensor (4) is highly sensitive and provides quick access to authorized users. The system also includes a locking base (6) with a locking mechanism (7), activated when an authorized user is identified by the biometric sensor (4), allowing access to the gun trigger. Powered by a battery (8), the system has an alert (9) for low battery. Additionally, it is adaptable to different types and sizes of weapons and can register multiple users, making it suitable for use in police or military forces. The field of application is directed to the sector of safety equipment, more particularly, in secure storage devices for firearms.

title: Firearm Safety Assembly
abstract: A firearm safety assembly for preventing the firearm from being discharged by an unauthorized user includes a processor coupled to a firearm. A fingerprint scanner is coupled to the firearm. The fingerprint scanner may read an authorized user's fingerprint. The fingerprint scanner is operationally coupled to the processor. A thumbprint scanner is coupled to the firearm. The thumbprint scanner may read the authorized user's thumbprint. The thumbprint scanner is operationally coupled to the processor. A trigger lock is coupled to the firearm. The trigger lock is operationally coupled to the processor. The trigger lock allows the firearm to be fired when the processor receives the authorized user's fingerprint and thumbprint. A GPS is coupled to the firearm. The GPS is operationally coupled to the processor. The GPS determining a location of the firearm.

title: Personalized intelligent identification police-used gun management device and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a personalized intelligent identification police-used gun management device and system. The device comprises a single chip microcomputer, a lock body unit, anintelligent identification unit, a positioning unit, a communication unit and a power supply unit, wherein the single chip microcomputer is arranged in a gun and connected with the other five units, the lock body unit comprises a trigger lock and a gun sleeve lock, the intelligent identification unit adopts fingerprint identification, the positioning unit adopts a GPS unit, and the communication unit comprises a Bluetooth unit and a GPRS unit; and the intelligent identification unit collects user fingerprints and compares the user fingerprints with fingerprint data typed in the single chip microcomputer in advance, the single chip microcomputer controls opening and closing of the trigger lock according to a comparison result, the gun geographic position information transmitted by the GPS unit through the GPRS unit can be inquired on a mobile terminal in real time, and the power supply unit supplies power to a gun-end power supply through wireless charging. According to the personalizedintelligent identification police-used gun management device and system, personalization of a police-used gun can be achieved, the gun is locked as soon as the gun is separated from the hand, an opponent can not use the gun after the gun is snatched, and the gun can be found through a real-time positioning function after being lost.

title: Gun System and Gun Control Management System Prohibit Gun Violence in Reactive and Proactive
abstract: The Gun System and Gun-Control Management System is a two part system to thwart gun violence in any places. The Gun System is a microprocessor with memory and supporting components that are embedded in the gun. The CPU of the Gun System executes software with data from the memory to identify authorized users with stand-alone electrical device; to discharge Unauthorized user with remote power switch or systems; to prohibit firearm use in restricted areas such as schools and other public places with GPS device and disable the gun trigger by moving it into the locked position with disabling device. In this way, the gun system thwarts gun violence in a reactive mode. The Gun-Control Management system maintains a plurality of database in communication with multiple gun systems to thwarts gun violence in proactive mode.

title: Biometric firearm trigger lock with alarm
abstract: This disclosure provides a trigger lock system that includes a trigger lock that collects a fingerprint and unlocks when the fingerprint matches a stored fingerprint. The trigger lock in-cludes a wireless communication module, for example, Bluetooth module and a Thread module, such that it can connect to a user device by Bluetooth or internet through a Thread router. The trigger lock may be unlocked remotely by sending a command from the user device. The trigger lock may send information of each attempt to unlock the trigger lock by fingerprint to the user device. The trigger lock may send alerts to the user device. The trigger lock also includes an alarm that produces alert when unauthorized personnel attempts to unlock the trigger lock.

abstract: The invention discloses a gun trigger unlocked through biological fingerprint identification. title: Fingerprint recognition safety systems
abstract: A universal fingerprint recognition system for firearms that greatly reduces misuse and accidental discharge of a firearm. The fingerprint recognition assembly is completely embedded within the firearm to prevent tampering. A chip embedded in the trigger scans the firearm owner's fingerprint, and when recognized releases a safety pin, allowing the trigger to be pulled. A charging port embedded in the firearm's grip allows a USB-type connector to be attached and charge the battery chip in the CPU.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gun trigger locks, in particular to a gun trigger lock, in a locking state, a user uses fingerprints set in a fingerprint module on a circuit board by himself to unlock the lock, in the locking state, a supporting rod of a cam faces downwards and is not in contact with a spring bolt piece, and in the locking state, the supporting rod of the cam is not in contact with the spring bolt piece. The lock tongue head of the lock tongue piece extends into the lock hook side clamping groove of the lock hook piece, so that the lock hook piece cannot be pulled out, connection of the upper shell and the lower shell of the lock is achieved, a locked object located between the upper shell and the lower shell cannot be separated out, and the locking function is achieved. title: Firearm system and method thereof
abstract: This invention relates to a firearm system using biometric fingerprint recognition technology to ensure exclusive operation by authorized individuals. The system integrates a distinct fingerprint scanner into the firearm's grip, allowing activation and firing solely by users with registered fingerprints. The design, functioning, and components of the biometric-enabled firearm system, bolstering security and thwarting unauthorized access. The system includes a biometric sensor 102, processor 106, database, user interface, and additional security features such as tamper detection and emergency override. It transforms firearm security by incorporating biometric authentication technology, setting a new standard for safety, accountability, and traceability in firearm usage.

title: trigger Lock System with Digital Fireweapons Sensor
abstract: TRIGGER LOCK SYSTEM WITH DIGITAL FIRE ENGINE SENSOR. The electronic firearm lock system reads the fingerprint of the finger, confronts this information with your database, and authorizes people to fire with the gun. title: Weapon trigger interlock and monitoring system
abstract: A firearm activation and monitoring system which tracks, monitors, and automatically prevents a firearm from firing when a user is not in a suitable state of mind or is not an authorized user, as well as a method for activating and monitoring a firearm. The firearm activation and monitoring system generally comprises a firearm having a trigger and grip area, a plurality of biometric sensors located on the grip area which measure biometric data of a user, a trigger interlock, and a main microcontroller. The trigger interlock prevents the trigger from firing the firearm when the trigger interlock is in its normal or default position. To unlock the trigger, the user holds the grip area to activate the biometric sensors, and if the user is in an acceptable mental state, the main microcontroller will send an electrical signal to the trigger interlock, which unlocks the trigger and allows the user to pull the trigger of the firearm.

title: Securing mechanisms for preventing access to a firearm by unauthorized users, and safety housings for use therewith
abstract: A securing mechanism for use in a holster, gun safe, base station, recharging/docking station, gun rack, or other safety housing for a firearm or other item, including one or more retaining members that engage the trigger guard, barrel, or other part of the firearm to prevent withdrawal of the firearm from the safety housing by anyone other than an authorized user of the firearm. The securing mechanism includes a biometric identification mechanism such as a fingerprint sensor for scanning fingerprint information of a prospective user of the firearm, and a processor for comparing the scanned biometric information with stored biometric information of an authorized user and releasing the retaining member only if the scanned biometric information matches that of the authorized user.

title: Fingerprint collection device for access control and personal weapons and other systems controlled thereby
abstract: The numerical aperture (NA) of the optical fiber is reduced to allow the cross-lighting phenomenon of the optical fiber prism assembly to be tolerated so as not to exceed 0.5 if possible. A substantial portion of the light travels along the optical fiber based on a fine image, such as a fingerprint, at an input end of the assembly. At the assembly output, a detector responds to the electrical signal arrangement based on the surface undulations. These signals are processed to check the identity of fingerprints or the like, as well as used to control access to personal weapons, other equipment, facilities, data, or money services. As much as possible, the assembly uses a separation element such as, for example, an optical fiber taper (through which the input light does not cross) that is high NA due to out-of-area absorption of the EMA material. In the case of weapons, an anti-oversight module (which matches the weapon port and must also be cosmetically embodied) holds a portion of the access control and firing system. Bullets and the like are fired only when a specific signal is generated from the module.

title: Firearm safety system
abstract: A firearm safety system restricts the use of the firearm by reference to biometric data received by a sensor (23) coupled to the firearm trigger (26). The biometric data is compared to at least one record of biometric data associated with a permitted user to determine whether firearm actuation is permitted. Firearm actuation is controlled by an anchor (24) that is pivotally coupled to the firearm trigger (26). Firearm actuation is prevented when the anchor is extended between the trigger (26) and the trigger aperture (21). Firearm actuation is permited when the anchor (24) is retracted in response to a positive identification by the sensor (23).

title: Sniper rifle
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of creating a special sniper rifle for conducting targeted operations against enemy terrorist groups near our border and within the country, and also is capable of engaging low-flying air targets (helicopters, UAVs), external equipment of enemy tanks and armored personnel carriers, snipers and is a weapon of small airborne units, long-range infantry reconnaissance groups, etc. In the 75 years since the end of the Second World War, many different models of sniper rifles have been created in the world. This firearm device contains a means of protection against firing by an unregistered person, and has a means of information storage consisting of an image in an electronic system for controlling the firing from the presented weapon, and also stores a special code connected to each bullet fired and a laser system for forming a laser beam that ignites the charge for firing the bullet. Furthermore, the means for protecting the weapon contains physical information intended for allowing the firing from this firearm. Here, physical information is the fingerprint of a person about to use a given firearm, through which that person can be identified. title: Gun inspection room system based on face recognition and voiceprint recognition
abstract: The invention provides a gun inspection room system based on face recognition and voiceprint recognition. The gun inspection room system based on face recognition and voiceprint recognition comprises a sound insulation room which is provided with a sound insulation mechanism, an access control device which is arranged at the entrance of the sound insulation room and comprises face recognition or/and voiceprint recognition, a gun model acquisition device which is arranged in the sound insulation room and is used for acquiring the model of the gun to be inspected, a recording device which comprises a microphone array and is used for extracting the audio signals of which the distances are within a preset threshold range as audio signals to be identified, and an audio comparison device which stores a standard gun inspection audio signal database associated with different types of guns and is used for calling the standard gun inspection audio signals of the types of the guns to be inspected, comparing the audio signals to be identified with the standard gun inspection audio signals and judging whether the gun inspection action is completed or not.

title: Internet of things based position tracking intergration weapon management system
abstract: A location tracking type integrated weapon management system based on internet of things includes: at least one field arsenal which stores weapons such as firearms or magazines; a field manager terminal which stores information related to an approval of carry-out of weapons in a DB; and a remote responsible person terminal which receives, stores, and monitors the related information stored by the field manager terminal. The related information includes identification information of carry-out of a weapon and weapon information; information related to the weapon is read and transmitted by a reader by attaching an NFC tag for recognition to the weapon; an identification process is performed by a face recognition device about a person who returns the carry-out of the weapon; and situations of carry-in and carry-out of the weapon are recorded by attaching a camera capable of photographing an area around the field arsenal. The field manager terminal enables an approval process after identification by receiving identification information by the face recognition device; a GPS module is mounted in the weapon; the real-time location of carry-out of the weapon is grasped by displaying the location information of carry-out of the weapon through the GPS module on a GIS map; a wired/wireless service is possible in all positions capable of internet by building a clouding system connected to an integrated management server between the field manager terminal and the remote responsible person terminal; and a system can be expanded without stopping a service.

abstract: The present invention relates to a smart control and monitoring system for a gun. The smart control and monitoring system is detachably attached to the gun. title: Portable intelligent gun box device
abstract: The invention discloses a portable intelligent gun box device, which comprises a power module circuit, an ARM processor platform and a fingerprint acquisition module circuit, wherein the power module circuit is connected onto power ends of the ARM processor platform, the fingerprint acquisition module circuit, a GPS&GPRS module circuit and a peripheral module circuit for providing power; and the CAMER interface of the ARM processor platform is connected with the fingerprint acquisition module circuit for fingerprint extraction and comparison, and only an authorized legal user can open the gun box. The fact that the fingerprint for the identity of a gun-taking person is quickly compared and the gun box is legally opened can be realized, remote increased and decreased authorization on the identity of the gun-taking person can be realized, the fact that each gun box has a global unique ID series number can be realized, and the uniqueness of each gun box is ensured; the fact that the position unlocking information and the unlocking time of the gun-taking person are recorded to the gun box device for facilitating query is realized; the portable intelligent gun box device is applicable to military and public security exercises for realizing quick gun-taking person identity recognition, remote monitoring and real-time authorization; and due to records of the gun-taking person identity information, the time and the space, supervision by a relevant department is facilitated.

title: Techniques for dynamically managing a gun component
abstract: The present disclosure provides systems and techniques for dynamically operating a peripheral component of a gun, such as a flashlight, an electronic sight, or a haptic motor. The gun may perform an authentication procedure to identify a user operating the gun, retrieve a configuration file from memory housed in the gun in response to the authentication procedure, and perform a function at the peripheral component based on the configuration file indicating that the function is to be performed for the user. The gun may collect authentication data, such as biometric data or token data, and the gun may identify the user operating the gun based on the authentication data. The user operating the gun may be identified in response to matching the collected authentication data to authentication data stored in the memory, and the gun may determine the function based on the configuration file indicating the function for the user.

title: System and method for monitoring and securing a military weapon
abstract: A system (100) for monitoring and securing a military weapon is disclosed. A biometric sensing chip (102) senses fingerprint of a user. A biometric recognition module (110) receives user recognition data representative of sensed fingerprint of the user, matches the user recognition data with historical user recognition data, identifies authentication of the user using a neural network accelerator. An access control module (120) enables access to the user for using the military weapon. A data monitoring and securing module (130) tracks user handling data representative of usage of the military weapon by the user in real-time, encrypts the user handling data for security purpose using a physical unclonable function based key generation technique. An actuation module (140) determines pressure of a finger of the user when the access for using the military weapon is obtained, sends activation signal for triggering of the military weapon by based on the pressure determined.

title: Intelligent safety lock for gun
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent safety lock for a gun. The intelligent safety lock for the gun comprises a left lock base and a right lock base which are locked to each other, wherein the right lock base comprises a lock frame, a spring, a plug pin, a positioning frame, an electromagnetic guiding head, an electromagnetic coil, an intelligent fingerprint processing module, a lock base shell and a fingerprint collecting plate, the lock frame is fixedly connected with the lock base shell, a containing cavity is formed in the lock frame, the positioning frame, the electromagnetic guiding head, the electromagnetic coil and the intelligent fingerprint processing module are arranged in the containing cavity, a protruding column is arranged outside the lock frame and provided with an infrared induction device, and the positioning frame is provided with a through hole for the plug pin to penetrate through; the left lock base is provided with a column groove matched with the protruding column, the column groove is provided with a metal inserting core, and the metal inserting pin is provided with an inserting hole matched with the plug pin; the fingerprint collecting plate, the infrared induction device, the intelligent fingerprint processing module and the electromagnetic coil are connected through electric signals. According to the intelligent safety lock for the gun, the safety lock is opened in a fingerprint recognition mode, safety performance is higher, locking and unlocking can be fast achieved, and the intelligent safety lock for the gun is easy and convenient to operate and more reliable in use.

title: Finger print identifying firearms
abstract: The utility model discloses a firearm with fingerprint identification function comprising a power supply, a power supply switch which is connected with the power supply, a fingerprint sensor which is connected with the power supply switch and is used to collect fingerprint signal, a fingerprint identification module which is connected with the power supply switch and is used to receive the fingerprint signal collected by the fingerprint sensor and to judge whether the fingerprint signal is matched with a fingerprint sample which is pre-stored in the fingerprint identification module, an electrical control and mechanical bolt driving circuit is connected with the power supply switch and is used to drive an electrical control and mechanical bolt which is connected with the fingerprint identification module during the process of fingerprint matching and an electrical control and mechanical bolt, wherein the fingerprint sensor is arranged on the position where the finger is put when the firearm is held.

title: Lightweight trigger mechanism-based instant threat early warning and active traceability deterrence method and system in power system network
abstract: The invention discloses an instant threat early warning and active traceability deterrence method and system based on a lightweight trigger mechanism in a power system network, and relates to the field of power system network security. According to the method, a light load trip line is preset at a key node, a suspicious attack log is generated in combination with a hidden Markov model, and multi-channel instant early warning is triggered; extracting multi-dimensional fingerprints of a browser, hardware and a special network weapon to construct a warehouse, and generating three types of flight fragments of deep acquisition, remote control and vulnerability repair for precise delivery; and performing confusion packing processing on the control software, and realizing active traceability deterrence in a matching/non-matching mode. According to the invention, threat identification accuracy and response speed are improved, an active defense closed loop is formed, and the method is suitable for security protection of a power system network.

title: Intelligent gun security lock
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent gun security lock which comprises a left lock seat and a right lock seat which are interlocked. The left lock seat and the right lock seat can be fixed and clamped to the position of a trigger of a gun after being interlocked. The right lock seat comprises a lock rack and a lock seat shell. The lock seat shell is provided with a fingerprint collection board. The lock rack and the lock seat shell are fixedly connected into a whole, and a containing cavity is formed inside the space formed after the lock rack and the lock seat shell are connected into a whole. A locking mechanism, an intelligent fingerprint processing module and a motor are installed in the containing cavity. The left lock seat is provided with a spring bolt which can extend into the containing cavity of the right lock seat and is matched with the locking mechanism in a locking mode. The fingerprint collection board, the intelligent fingerprint processing module and the motor are in electrical signal connection. The intelligent gun security lock is unlocked in a fingerprint identification mode, the safety performance is higher, locking and unlocking can be achieved rapidly, operation is easy and convenient, and use is more reliable.

title: Electronic lock system of firearms trigger
abstract: The Electronic Lock System of Firearms Trigger receives a long-distance command (remote control), via radio control, to lock the trigger of the weapon, verifies the database if this command is valid and sent by management team and, if so, keeps the trigger locked or locks it, and does not allow unauthorized people make use of the weapon. The Electronic Locking System of Firearms Trigger consists of a transceiver - transmitter / receiver (2), which will receive the command from long- distance lock. The received information will be analyzed by a microcontroller (3) that it will give the permission to make shots. The decision will be sent to a microdrive (4) that, if the user has authorization, or if there is no order of locked, release the trigger (6). If the user has been unauthorized remotely by management team, the trigger (6) will not be released. If the trigger (6) already released and a locked command is sent during use, a decision will be sent from the microcontroller (3) to the microdrive (4), that it will lock the trigger (6) and prevent the user from making new shots.

title: Firearm with User Identification System
abstract: A firearm system includes a firearm and a user identification system built-in with the firearm. The user identification system includes a locking module that releasably locks up a trigger-actuated firing mechanism of the firearm from being actuated, a camera module being activated for generating tangible evidence of operation incidents, and an activation module operatively linked to the locking module. The activation module pre-stores authorized user data and continuously collects user operation data not only to activate the camera module for capturing image but also to actuate the locking module to unlock the trigger-actuated firing mechanism when the authorized user data is matched with the user operation data. Once the authorized user data is not match with the user operation data, the trigger-actuated firing mechanism is instantaneously locked to prevent an unauthorized usage of the firearm.

title: Devices, systems and methods for firearms training, simulation and operations
abstract: Methods and apparatus for providing firearms training without using traditional firearms. Replicas of firearms have control systems in communication with magazines inserted into the replicas to control the number of rounds that can be fired for each magazine. The control systems can also monitor, record and communicate data relating to all use of the replica to centralized control units. Additionally, the control systems can include location sensors to monitor the location of the replicas and only authorize firing of the replicas in approved locations.

title: Safety control device for fire guns
abstract: The invention discloses a safety control device for fire guns. A battery module, a motion sensing module, a remote communication module, an identity verifying module and an electronic unlocking moduleof the safety control device for the fire guns are separately connected to a controller mutually; the input end of a lock body is connected to the output end of the electronic unlocking module; the motion sensing module is used for obtaining a motion state of the controller, and outputting a motion state signal to the controller; the controller outputs the motion state signal, and outputs a firstcontrol signal for controlling on/off of the remote communication module; the remote communication module receives an authorized signal of a remote server, and outputs a first unlocking signal to thecontroller; the identify verifying module receives a biological identifying signal of a fire gun user to verify, and outputs a second unlocking signal to the controller after verification is passed;and the electronic unlocking module is used for controlling opening of the lock body according to the first unlocking signal and/or the second unlocking signal. The scheme improves use safety of the gun fires of a gun fire unit.

title: Geolocation-reporting weapon-tracking device
abstract: Provided is a method that includes determining a device geolocation based on a satellite signal received by a weapon-tracking device and receiving a sensor reading using a sensor attached to the weapon-tracking device, wherein the sensor is sensitive to a use of the weapon. The instructions include determining that a change in the sensor reading satisfies a change threshold and, in response to a determination that the change threshold is satisfied, transmitting device state data to a wireless signal receiver via a wireless signal, wherein the device state data comprises a device identifier and the device geolocation. The instructions further include storing the device identifier and the device geolocation in a data server in communication with the wireless signal receiver and transmitting a message based on the device identifier and device geolocation to a client from the data server.

abstract: A system for automated respiratory medicine delivery is comprising, an inhaler 101 is equipped with a gun barrel assembly 102 at its bottom periphery to dispense respiratory medicine to a user, multiple canisters 103 within the assembly 102 is paired with an actuator 104 for controlled dispensing of respective medicine, an AI (artificial intelligence)-enabled camera 105 with embedded optical character recognition (OCR) is positioned on the inhaler's outer surface to extract dosage information from medical prescriptions, a wristband 106, communicatively linked to the inhaler 101, is embedded with multiple health monitoring sensors, a GPS module for tracking the user's location, a microphone 107 to monitor voice and coughing patterns in real time, a database stores user respiratory health data, a mobile application on a computing device allows user interaction with system functions, a buzzer 109 and speaker 110 on the wristband 106 provide alerts.

title: Target range management system
abstract: A target range management system disclosed by the present invention comprises an identity collector used for collecting the identity information of a shooting user at a target position; an identity verification server which is used for being in communication connection with the identity collector, obtaining the identity information sent by the identity collector and verifying the identity information; and a target range weapon control server which is used for being connected with the identity verification server and unlocking a weapon for the target position when the identity information passes the verification. Through the arrangement of the identity collector and the identity verification server, the purpose of verifying the collected identity of the shooting user is achieved, the effectof managing the shooting user is achieved, and the problems that in related shooting training management, due to dependence on manual management, the management efficiency is low, and the identity ofthe user cannot be distinguished are solved.

abstract: A gun lock of a firearm, the gun lock comprising: a plurality of sensors configured to collect profile information of a user of the firearm; a computing system coupled to the plurality of sensors, the computing system configured to determine whether the user of the firearm is authorized to operate the firearm based on the profile information of the user of the firearm and pre-stored authorized profile database; an actuator coupled to the computing system; a first connecting structure mechanically coupled to the actuator; a second connecting structure mechanically coupled to the first connecting structure; and a third connecting structuring mechanically coupled to the second connecting structure, wherein the computing system is configured to generate a control instruction following determining whether the user of the firearm is authorized to operate the firearm, and the computing system is further configured to transmit the control instruction to the actuator.

title: Anti-dismounting device of gun law enforcement recorder
abstract: The utility model relates to an anti-dismounting device, in particular to an anti-dismounting device of a gun law enforcement recorder. The device comprises a first shell and a second shell, the two parts are combined to form a cavity in which the law enforcement recorder is arranged; the device further comprises a first sealing box, a second sealing box, an unlocking device, a second fixing frame, a self-locking device, a second shell, a connecting piece and a fixing piece, the two ends of the second fixing frame and the two ends of the first fixing frame are connected and wrap the first shell and the second shell respectively, and the edges of the two shells are clamped in inner grooves of the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame; the self-locking device is mounted in the firstsealing box and the second sealing box; the law enforcement recorder protection device overcomes the defects that an existing law enforcement recorder is directly exposed and a single machine storesinformation, can prevent the law enforcement recorder from being damaged deliberately, can automatically identify risks, and can transmit law enforcement information to an information terminal in time.

title: An acoustic gunshot detection and alerting system using wireless rf communication networks
abstract: An Acoustic Gunshot Detection and Alerting System Using Wireless RF Communication Networks comprises of Processing Unit (01), MEMS Microphone Sensor (02), Sound Pressure Level Sensor (03), Infrasound Detection Sensor (04), Real-Time Clock Module (05), nRF Wireless Communication Module (06), Power Supply Unit (07), Processing Unit (30), GPS Localization Module (31), Motion Detection Sensor (32), Image Capture Module (33), Vibration Detection Sensor (34), nRF Wireless Communication Module (35), Power Supply Unit (36), Processing Unit (60), Temperature and Humidity Sensor (61), Wind Speed Sensor (62), Ambient Light Sensor (63), Rain Detection Sensor (64), nRF Wireless Communication Module (65), Power Supply Unit (66), Processing Unit (80), nRF Coordinator Module (81), GSM Communication Module (82), Cloud Data Logging Module (83), Alert Display Unit (84), Cloud Server / Monitoring Dashboard (85), Power Supply Unit (86). The Acoustic Sensing and Detection Node (Node 1), equipped with a MEMS Microphone, SPL Meter, Infrasound Sensor, Real-Time Clock (RTC) Module, nRF Module, and Power Supply, enables continuous multilayered automated gunshot acoustic signature detection by simultaneously capturing high-sensitivity acoustic waveforms, measuring impulsive sound pressure events exceeding gunshot thresholds, and detecting low-frequency blast pressure waves uniquely characteristic of firearm discharges, ensuring real-time gunshot event detection with legally precise timestamped incident records wirelessly transmitted to the centralized incident management platform.

title: Firearm holster lock with fingerprint identification means
abstract: Disclosed is a retaining device for lockingly receiving a firearm wherein the firearm has a barrel, barrel sight, grip, hammer and trigger guard. The retaining device comprises a holster (34), having a closed forward portion and an open rearward portion. A guide channel is positioned within the holster for accepting the barrel (22) and trigger guard of the firearm. A fingerprint identification means has a fingerprint input device (54) positioned upon the external surface of the holster at an intermediate extent. Further provided is a comparison means for comparing an inputted fingerprint with a stored fingerprint image, and a signal generating means for generating a first signal when an inputted fingerprint matches a stored fingerprint and a second signal when an inputted fingerprint fails to match a stored fingerprint. The signal generating means is in electrical communication with and controls a firearm retaining means. The firearm retaining means has a first orientation securing the firearm within the holster and a second orientation allowing the firearm to be removed. The retaining means is in electrical communication with and responsive to signals from the signal generating means.

abstract: The invention relates to a personal weapon for automatic firing of caseless ammunition, provided with an electronic firing controller with biometric identification of the person firing. Buffer grooves are formed in the positions, opposite to the hanging frames, in the inner cabinet body. Through the cooperation of the main trigger switch, the illuminating lamp, the bright camera and the dark camera, corresponding image data can be left when a thief pries up the bullet cabinet, then the identity of the thief can be conveniently and rapidly locked, and the difficulty of finding guns and ammunitions is reduced.

title: Secured firearm
abstract: The present invention describes a secured firearm, including semi-automatic pistols and revolvers, which has a permanently mounted locking device 1 in front of a trigger guard 3 and under a barrel 4. The locking device 1 locks a locking bar 7 which restricts the movement of a slide 5 or a cylinder 30, thereby disabling the secured firearm. The locking device 1 is attached to the outside of the secured firearm. Therefor, the impact on the inside of the secured firearm can be minimized. Any kind of lock can be used as the locking device 1 as long as it is compact enough to be installed in the housing of the locking device 1. For example, a key lock, a combination lock, an electric lock, and a biometric lock such as fingerprint authentication are all applicable to the locking device 1. The locking device 1 is fixed to the secured firearm firmly with screws from inside of the frame, whereby unauthorized dismantling of the locking device 1 is prevented. There is no possibility that the locking device 1 is lost during the secured firearm is used. It does not contact a trigger nor a hammer. Therefore, there is no possibility of accidental firing of the secured firearm due to mishandling of the locking device 1. The locking device 1 is applicable to both current handguns and newly designed handguns.

abstract: A biometric firearms safety system includes a firearm that has a grip and an action. A fingerprint unit is coupled to the firearm. The locking unit is electrically coupled to the fingerprint unit. The locking unit disengages from the action when the user's fingerprints match the authorized user's fingerprints. Thus, the locking unit facilitates the user to load and fire the firearm.

abstract: A locking system for firearms that utilizes an owner's fingerprint to lock and unlock it is disclosed. Upon initial observation of the invention, it appears like a conventional fire arm lock that goes around the trigger and immobilizes it. Fingerprint sensors are provided that will only acknowledge the fingerprint and thumb print of the gun owner. A small computerized chip, in conjunction with a lithium battery and an advancement mechanism such as a stepper motor perform the actual locking duties. The housing of the invention is made of titanium to prevent tampering.

title: Vehicle starting reminding control method, vehicle control unit, system and vehicle
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a vehicle starting reminding control method, a vehicle control unit, a system and a vehicle. The method comprises the steps that a power anti-theft authentication request transmitted by a one-key starting controller is received; the connection state of a charging and discharging port and a charging and discharging gun is detected according to the power anti-theft authentication request; and when it is determined that the charging and discharging port is connected with the charging and discharging gun, the vehicle is kept in a non-driving state, and first warning information is sent to an instrument. title: Systems and methods for preventing friendly fire through infrared recognition and authentication
abstract: Systems and methods prevent friendly fire using infrared object recognition. An IR projector projects a beam of IR radiation at a first wavelength onto the object and an IR detector, having a field of view of the object, detects IR fluorescence from the object, where a wavelength of the fluorescence is a function of the first wavelength. The system includes a memory for storing software having machine readable instructions that, when executed by a processor, perform the steps of: (a) controlling the IR projector to generate IR at the first wavelength; (b) controlling the IR detector to capture the object fluorescence; and (c) identifying the object as friendly or non-friendly based upon the object fluorescence. The system further includes an inhibitor for preventing firing of a gun or missile when the object is identified as friendly.

title: Direct-current vehicle-to-vehicle charging and discharging system and control guide circuit and charging and discharging interaction method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a direct-current vehicle-to-vehicle charging and discharging system and a control guide circuit and a charging and discharging interaction method thereof, and the system comprises a discharging vehicle, a charging vehicle, and a gun line connected between the discharging vehicle and the charging vehicle. The control guide circuit comprises a first identification module and a second confirmation module which are arranged at one end of the discharge vehicle, the first identification module is configured to generate a first identification signal based on the connection state of the gun wire, and the first identification signal is used for representing the current-carrying capacity of the gun wire and whether the gun wire is successfully connected or not; the second confirmation module is configured to provide a target power supply for the gun line by closing a switch component arranged in the second confirmation module so as to control closing of the electromagnetic lock in the communication loop, and the communication loop between the discharging vehicle and the charging vehicle is established. Therefore, by arranging the first identification module and the second confirmation module, it can be ensured that charging and discharging are started only when gun line connection is normal and locking is normal, and the safety and reliability of the system are improved.

title: Security devices and methods for regulating access to items secured within
abstract: Security holsters and methods for securing a firearm are provided. In one example, the security holster includes: a body including a cavity for receiving the firearm; a locking mechanism extending at least partially into the cavity for selectively securing at least a portion of the firearm within the cavity; an access authentication assembly configured to receive/provide authentication data for determining if a requesting user requesting access to the firearm is an authorized user; a device condition sensor configured to provide device condition data associated with at least one of the security holster and an environment in proximity to the security holster; and a computing device operably coupled to the locking mechanism, the access authentication assembly, and the device condition sensor, and configured to regulate the security holster between a locked configuration where access to the firearm is denied and an unlocked configuration where the firearm is accessible.

title: Charging and discharging integrated gun identity recognition control module and control circuit applying same
abstract: The invention discloses a charging and discharging integrated gun identity recognition control module which comprises a first identity recognition chip, and a chip control pin electrically connected with the first identity recognition chip is arranged on an MCU module. The first identity recognition chip is arranged in the plug end, and at least first identity recognition information and charging and discharging parameter information are pre-stored in the first identity recognition chip; the first identity recognition information is bidirectional authentication information of a vehicle or a butt joint accessory matched with the charging and discharging integrated gun; when a gun head body of the charging and discharging integrated gun is connected to a vehicle and a plug end enters a charging mode or a discharging mode, the MCU module reads identity recognition information on the first identity recognition chip and judges whether the first identity recognition information is matched or not, if yes, charging is started in the charging mode, and discharging waiting is started in the discharging mode; and if not, charging or discharging is not carried out. The invention further discloses a charging and discharging integrated gun control circuit comprising the identity recognition control module. Through identity recognition, intelligent service can be realized, and meanwhile, potential safety hazards caused by misoperation are avoided.

abstract: A firearm, the firearm comprising: a grip; a transparent window located on the rear of the grip; at least one electromagnetic sensor located within the grip, and configured to receive electromagnetic radiation from outside of the grip through the transparent window; a computing device located in the grip and in communication with the LED and the electromagnetic sensor; where the electromagnetic sensor is configured to detect incoming electromagnetic radiation traveling through the transparent window from outside of the grip; and the computing device is configured to allow the firearm to fire if the computing device determines that the incoming electromagnetic radiation corresponds to an authorized user for the firearm. A firearm system, the firearm comprising: an external charging circuit, the external charging circuit comprising: a resonant inductive coil; a power supply in operable communication with the coil; a rechargeable power storage device in operable communication with the coil; a firearm configured to removably connect to the external charging circuit, the firearm comprising: a resonant inductive coil; a power supply in operable communication with the coil; a rechargeable storage device in operable communication with the coil; firearm electronics in operable communication with the power supply; mechanical controls in operable communication with the power supply; a mechanical squeeze generator in operable communication with the power supply.

title: Electronic arms security system and method for securing a firearm
abstract: The invention relates to an arms security system, comprising a first touch-sensitive user interface for receiving user data characterising a user. This first touch-sensitive user interface is located in a contact area of an arm that is touched by the user in order to shoot. The arms security system also has a control device comprising an input unit for receiving user data, a computer unit for checking user data and an output unit. If the user data check is successful, indicating that the user is authorised to use the arm, the output unit emits a release signal in order to release the trigger mechanism of the arm. The arms security system comprises a user terminal for providing the touch-sensitive user interface with the user data, said terminal having the user data and a body transmission device which is connected to the user for transmitting user data to the first touch-sensitive user interface when the latter is touched.

title: Weapon control system
abstract: A firearm control system for a firearm authorized for use by a person having a validated identity comprises a firearm having a frame, barrel, firing mechanism and trigger. An interlock system is provided for enabling and disabling operation of the firearm, the interlock system being disposed on the frame and including a communications/control module, a trigger module operatively connected to the communication/control module, and operatively connected to the trigger to sense attempted operation of the trigger by a user and send signals to the communications/control module, and a firing mechanism module operatively connected to the communication/control module, and to the firing mechanism to enable or disable operation of the firing mechanism. The interlock system operates to enable and disable operation of the firearm based on signals sent to, and received from, the communications/control module.

abstract: FIELD: controlling.SUBSTANCE: invention is intended for fire control systems (FCS) for conventional (non-guided) weapons of heavy ground-based robotic strike systems (HGRSS) based on serial armoured vehicles (AV). The fire control system of a combat vehicle comprises an information-computing sighting system composed of optoelectronic instruments for observation and aiming, for measuring the range to the target and firing, automatic firing condition sensors, and a ballistic computer, as well as a weapon stabilisation and guidance system. The system therein includes an electronic hardware and software unit, supplied at the inputs with electrical signals from the computing apparatus and the control unit of the weapon stabiliser, corresponding to the current values of the controlled parameters, and at the outputs, forming signals providing configuration and display of data on the technical condition of the system for members of the crew or the operator in case of non-crewed application of the object.EFFECT: increase in the efficiency of preparation for combat application of the fire control system of heavy ground-based robotic strike systems based on serial AV.1 cl, 2 dwg, 1 tbl

title: A firearm having an intelligent controller
abstract: A firearm having a programmable electronic control (28) for firing electrically ignitable ammunition (17) has a user authorization apparatus (34) and the capability to receive inputs from a plurality of sensors including a magazine presence sensor, a Round-In-Chamber sensor, grip sensors, and a battery status sensor. The electronic control (28) of the present invention has a programmable microcontroller (30), a power supply system using batteries (24), an ignition system that converts low level voltage from the batteries (24) to the required voltage to fire the electrically ignitable ammunition (17), a user authorization apparatus, and an options interface adaptable to receive inputs from system sensors. The firearm of the present invention is programmed to enable firing only if safe and authorized firing conditions are determined. The electronic control (28) can be implemented in either a pistol (1) having an ammunition magazine (23), a multichambered handgun or a revolver.

title: Electromechanical sear and methods of operating a gun using the same
abstract: The present disclosure provides systems and techniques for an electromechanical sear that is implementable in a gun. The gun may include a fire control manager, and the fire control manager may identify a trigger break based on a trigger sensor, transmit, based on the trigger break, a first signal to a first actuator located in a displacement path of a sear, so as to cause the first actuator to be displaced in a first direction, and transmit, based on the trigger break, a second signal to a second actuator located in the displacement path of the sear, so as to cause the second actuator to be displaced in a second direction. The transmitting the first signal to the first actuator and the transmitting the second signal to the second actuator may cause displacement of the sear and firing of the gun.

title: Firearm cubbyhole having a finger vein recognition system
abstract: The present invention related to a firearm cubbyhole having a finger vein recognition system comprises: a firearm holder allowing a firearm to be held in an inner space of a case member having a box-shape and including a plurality of movable firearm slots; a shock absorbing part installed at a lower end of the firearm holder to allow each firearm slot of the firearm holder to be turned frontwards and backwards at a predetermined angle; firearm locking device parts installed at positions corresponding to the upper end of gun barrels of firearms held by the firearm slots of the firearm holder and allowing the upper end of the gun barrels of the firearms to be hooked thereon to be fixed or to be released therefrom; a firearm cubbyhole controller processing a locking/unlocking function of the firearm locking device parts in accordance with whether to authenticate a finger vein of an individual user or manager and controlling an electric circuit function of the firearm cubbyhole; and a finger vein authentication part installed on one side of an exterior of the case member and detecting a finger vein signal of the user or manager in accordance with a control signal of the firearm cubbyhole to perform an authentication procedure. According to the present invention, the lock device parts are installed on the holder inside the firearm cubbyhole, and the slots of the firearm holder are individually controlled by a finger vein authentication method to discharge a firearm. Thus, after confirming the authority of a user through finger vein authentication, each firearm slot corresponding to the user is unlocked through the lock device part to discharge only the corresponding firearm, thereby maximizing safety and security in the management of firearms.

title: Method and apparatus for secure issuance of secure firearm identification credentials
abstract: The invention brings together the components of digital image capture and digital fingerprint capture to both speed up and make more secure the process of applying for a firearm permit and the process of issuing a firearm permit. Biometric data captured, such as face and finger, is used in both verifying the applicant's asserted identity (biometric verification) and in ensuring the applicant is not a member of a group (or database) of individuals who should not be granted a permit (biometric identification). Furthermore, the invention discusses issuing a credential that is inherently more secure than printed and laminated credentials that are ubiquitous today. The invention simultaneously improves service to residents via reduced credential issuance timelines, improves the security of who is issued a firearm credential, and improves the integrity of the firearm credential.

title: Gun lock
abstract: A gun lock, for blocking the trigger of a gun, comprising a first and second armored part. The armored parts are locked to each other covering the trigger and is connected to a power source and contains switching means for switching between a locked and an unlocked state. Furthermore a biometric sensor and a processor are positioned inside one of the armored parts for processing the data from the biometric sensor and allowing unlocking if the data match data from allowed users. The locking beam and the at least one support beam is configured to be positioned on either side of the trigger inside the trigger guard when in a locked state. The two armored parts covers at least the trigger and trigger guard.

title: Gun trigger lock
abstract: The invention discloses a gun trigger lock which comprises a lock body and a locking cover capable of being turned over relative to the lock body. The lock body is provided with an identity recognition device, a control circuit board, a drive device, a locking mechanism and a power source module. The identity recognition device is used for acquiring user identity information and sending the user identity information to the control circuit board. The control circuit board controls the drive device to act according to the comparison result of the identity information. The drive device drives the locking mechanism to act. The power module supplies power to the identity recognition device, the control circuit board and the drive device. The lock cover is provided with a buckle plate bucked to the locking mechanism. The gun trigger lock drops out when opened and is convenient to operate. A miniature worm and gear motor is adopted to drive the locking mechanism and is small in size, low in output power and beneficial to lightweight and miniaturization of the gun trigger lock. The gun trigger lock is further provided with a mechanical emergency unlocking mechanism. The gun trigger lock can be unlocked through the mechanical emergency unlocking mechanism under the emergency condition. A fingerprint unlocking manner, a sound unlocking manner, an RFID unlocking manner, a Bluetooth unlocking manner and the like can be selected and used for the identity recognition device.

title: Fingerprint gun lock apparatus
abstract: A fingerprint gun lock apparatus for quickly and safely locking and unlocking a trigger of a gun includes a frontside body having a frontside inner face with an extended portion and a recessed portion. A screw gear is coupled to a motor within a frontside inner cavity. A pair of locking pins each has a threaded end coupled to the screw gear, extends through a pair of pin apertures, and has a hooked distal end. The pair of locking pins secures a backside body to the frontside body around the trigger of the gun. A fingerprint scanner activates the motor to turn the screw gear and separate the pair of locking pins when an authorized fingerprint is touched to the scan side to allow the frontside body and the backside body to separate.

title: Electronic scale with face recognition function
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic scale with a face recognition function, and relates to the field of electronic scales with face recognition functions. The system comprises an electronic canning pile and a weighing platform, a liquid crystal operation screen and an NFC card reader are fixedly installed at the top of the front end of the electronic canning pile, a face recognition instrument is fixedly installed at the top end of the electronic canning pile, a filling gun is installed at the front end of the electronic canning pile, and a control switch is fixedly installed at the side end of the electronic canning pile. title: Intelligent identification gun
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of military industry and particularly relates to an intelligent identification gun. The gun comprises a grip and an actuating mechanism. The actuating mechanism comprises a gun locking device, a personnel identification device, a power source and a circuit. The personnel identification device is electrically connected with the gun locking device through the circuit and comprises an RFID unit and a fingerprint identification unit. The RFID unit comprises a personnel information verification end and a personnel information record end. The gun can be precisely managed through an intelligent grip system, and the management authority of the gun is limited within a smaller range; meanwhile, the using timeliness of the gun is fully optimized, and operation is convenient and efficient like a traditional gun; and the intelligent grip system adopts fingerprints and the RFID technology, the gun insurance can be removed through fingerprints of a user or an ID ring worn by the user, and the gun is automatically locked again when the grip is out of a hand, so that the situation that the gun is used by others is avoided.

title: Smart safety lock for guns
abstract: The invention discloses a smart safety lock for guns. The smart safety lock comprises a left lock seat and a right lock seat which are locked with each other. The right lock seat comprises a lock frame, a spring, a bolt, a positioning frame, an electromagnetic guide head, an electromagnetic coil, a smart fingerprint processing module, a lock seat shell and a fingerprint collecting plate, wherein the lock frame is fixedly connected with the lock seat shell, an accommodating cavity is formed inside the lock seat shell, the positioning frame, the electromagnetic guide head electromagnetic coil and the smart fingerprint processing module are disposed in the accommodating cavity, a protruding column is disposed on the outer side of the lock frame and provided with an infrared sensing device, and the positioning frame is provided with a through hole allowing the bolt to penetrate. The left lock seat is provided with a column groove matched with the protruding column. The column groove is provided with a metal insertion core. The metal insertion core is provided with an insertion hole matched with the bolt. The finger collecting plate, the infrared sensing device, the smart fingerprint processing module and the electromagnetic coil are in electric signal connection. The smart safety lock has the advantages that the safety lock is unlocked by fingerprint identification, locking and unlocking can be achieved fast, and the safety lock is high in safety performance, simple to operate and reliable.

F5_excerpt: The right lock seat comprises a lock frame, a spring, a bolt, a positioning frame, an electromagnetic guide head, an electromagnetic coil, a smart fingerprint processing module, a lock seat shell and a fingerprint collecting plate, wherein the lock frame is fixedly connected with the lock seat shell, an accommodating cavity is formed inside the lock seat shell, the positioning frame, the electromagnetic guide head electromagnetic coil and the smart fingerprint processing module are disposed in the accommodating cavity, a protruding column is disposed on the outer side of the lock frame and provided with an infrared sensing device, and the positioning frame is provided with a through hole allowing the bolt to penetrate.
